text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, what a lovely moonlit night♪ Magic 
practice should go great under this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
O moonlight, intensify your radiance! 
Evening Primrose!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, ah! The clouds are hiding the 
moon...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no! Now how am I supposed to know 
if the magic worked or not?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~~gh! I'm definitely not moving from 
this spot until it comes out againnn!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even after curfew, Sweep Tosho took her 
time returning to her room and ended up 
staying up late...
